text:
Situation: Mesalamine 0.375 g capsules are not on the FDA drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 49 capsules (5.5 days at 9 per day). Corvale Lakeside holds 50 capsules (27.4 days at 1.8 per day). Corvale General holds 163 capsules (17 days). The NDC label names Zydus Lifesciences Limited (FEI 3007938603) with a VAI inspection on 2023-03-24. FDA status is "To Be Discontinued" with no date provided.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows mesalamine is not listed as of 2026-10-21. The product carries a "To Be Discontinued" status without an associated date.

Our position: Internal supply is uneven. East is critically low. Lakeside and General have sufficient stock to support transfers without dropping below two weeks. No external shortage is declared. Alternate manufacturers are not on the shortage list but their labels do not identify plants we can verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 24 capsules from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
2. Transfer 28 capsules from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
3. Evaluate purchase from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc. — requires buyer approval.
4. Evaluate purchase from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited — requires buyer approval.
5. Evaluate purchase from Ascend Laboratories, LLC — requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: No action that relies on an FDA-declared shortage, as none exists.
